item.title: Talking Headways Podcast: Ed Roberts, Curb Cuts and the Origins of the Disability Movement
item.description: This week we’re joined by Professor Scot Danforth of Chapman University to discuss his book An Independent Man: Ed Roberts and the Fight for Disability Rights. We chat about the origins of the disability movement, and creating access for all.
